parameters.name: tube_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-34, D-54, kept by D-131 (the same outside sections in welded, galvanized steel box tube): 20 x 40; the 20 mm face carries the skin, so the 40 mm runs through the wall (outer_t = ACP 3 + frame 40)

parameters.name: tube_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: frame depth = outer panel 46 - skin 3 - bond 3 = 40 (D-34)

parameters.name: stud_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the same: the studs at 0.8 (no rivnut, only the skin's bond line)

parameters.name: plate_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the Joints Engineer's corner detail (2026-11-01 05:05): a 2 mm steel plate welded into each mitre, the members cut back so it fits, centred on the old mitre line

parameters.name: stile_pitch_max
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-11-01 (D-131 sample): the ACP flexes 2 mm or less under a 100 N push at a bay's centre, edges simply supported (make_acp_spans.py), so members about 300 apart; it was 400 (D-16, D-34)

parameters.name: skin_setback
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: skin edge set back from the frame's top and bottom edges: 0, so the outside reveal equals the 2.26 seam gap (D-23: crisp, aligned reveals; joints register 2.8 leaves the setback to the WALL drawing)

parameters.name: fill_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 40 mm PET fill fills the frame depth (D-34; layout study 40 mm)

parameters.name: bolt_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling on F-009: bolt holes 7.0 (0.51 float), position tolerance 0.4 (+-0.2) from the spigot hole, CNC or drill jig (joints register FR-02)

parameters.name: access_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: register FR-03: passes the 18 mm head washer (ISO 7093-1, R-J10), the M6 head and the 5 mm key; holds the grommet retainer (H-02)

parameters.name: bolt_line_y
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: J-WALL-02 bolt line on the back panel's tube centre, Y 824 (joints register R-J15, FR-07)

parameters.name: rivnut_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-163 (the Lead's ruling, 2026-11-01): Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 in a round drilled hole Ø10.00 +0.10/0, inside the maker's 10.00 +0.15/-0.0 (Sherex drawing CAL2-610-4.2 rev B, note 2) so the bolt-hole stack ST-03 stays positive; T06's spin-out test confirms it

parameters.name: spigot_d
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-05: hole for the 8 mm locating spigot H-05

parameters.name: spigot_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's spigot_inset: spigots 100 from each end of the edge (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J13)

parameters.name: bolt_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's bolt_edge_inset: end bolts 220 in from the panel's ends, evenly spaced, every bolt 30 or more from any stile (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J14)

parameters.name: pocket_w
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-10: fill left out 60 x 60 next to each bolt for the key

parameters.name: felt_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: plan VT03-PET 9 mm PET felt; HW-SEL A3; D-31 (the factory's felt)

parameters.name: tray_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-37: galvanised steel tray 0.5 mm

parameters.name: tray_h
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): the wall cassettes use the ceiling's tray, returns the full cassette depth (34) turned in as lips that hold the felt, no ribs; settles H09 for the walls

parameters.name: lip_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): 12 mm lips hold the felt edge

parameters.name: bend_r
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: inside bend radius 1 x t for 0.5 mm DX51D (the sheet metal rule's bend radius is its Thickness); the factory's tooling sets it (guideline 9)

parameters.name: felt_c
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: felt edge clearance inside the returns, as the ceiling cassette

parameters.name: gap_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: air gap between the tray base and the felt (24): the acoustic gap (D-17) and the cable path (D-26)

parameters.name: clip_zone_h
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: height of each reserved clip zone (H03: no clip named)

parameters.name: clip_zone_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: clip zone centre from the cassette's top and bottom edges (H03)

parameters.name: stopw_od
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: stop washer Ø10.5 x Ø20 x 1.5 (PROPOSED part)

parameters.name: stopw_id
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08

parameters.name: stopw_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: rivnut head 0.76 + washer 1.5 = the 2.26 stop (R-J5)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: flange Ø12.45 to 12.95, the largest modelled (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: flange 0.68 to 0.84, its middle; with the 1.5 stop washer the 2.26 stop (R-J5), as before (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_body_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: knurled body Ø9.91 max (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_len
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B, note 3: installed length 9.65 max under the flange (14.35 to 15.11 before setting); the bulge inside the tube is not modelled (D-163)

parameters.name: m6_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: M6 threads shown at their 6 mm major diameter (no modelled thread)

parameters.name: spigot_pin_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05: Ø8 stainless pin; the part itself is Joints' 831001 STEP, placed as it is (F-189)

parameters.name: spigot_proud
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05 and Joints' README: the pin's top 8.00 above the tube face (Z 7.24 above its origin on the rivnut head)

parameters.name: spigot_slot
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-05: the back panels' slot for the second spigot (D-167 lengthens the side panels' only)

parameters.name: tube_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the Joints Engineer's gauges for D-131 (2026-11-01): a back panel's perimeter members (rails, outer and centre stiles) at 1.0; the studs 0.8

parameters.name: lead_in
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register 2.10 (R-J9): 1 x 45 degree lead-in on the top edge of each closing-seam face, so the panel beside it drops in past it without catching the bulb seal

parameters.name: pnl_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: skeleton half_pw: the back panel's skin width (1200.61 on P04)

parameters.name: frm_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's half_fw, 1198.99: the frame stops close_gap / 2 from X 0 and 1.62 short of its skin (R-J16)

parameters.name: pnl_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: skeleton back row height (1118.61 on P04)

parameters.name: frm_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the frame fills the row height; the seam gaps are outside it (P04)

parameters.name: top_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the back panels' top rails stay 20 x 40 (the ceiling's back member is the 40 x 40, R-J3)

parameters.name: stile_n_mid
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: PM ruling 2026-11-01 (D-135): 3 studs on a back panel, so the skin flexes 1.99 mm under a 100 N push at 274.75 clear (make_acp_spans.py); a fixed count (the studs are copies held by joints), the pitch follows the width, and the build refuses a pitch over stile_pitch_max

parameters.name: stile_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: equal stile pitch, centre to centre

parameters.name: stile_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: studs between the rails (square ends, welded T joints, D-131); the perimeter stiles run the full height, mitred (D-117) and welded

parameters.name: n_len_bolt
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's n_base_bolt (4): also on the horizontal seam and the ceiling back edge (register 2.9; the skeleton's n_ceil_back_bolt 3 is an old assumption, flagged)

parameters.name: len_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 253.00 on P04: 220, 473.00, 725.99, 978.99 from the frame's ends (register 2.9; the skeleton's back_base_pitch uses the 1200.61 skin and gives 253.54, flagged to its owner)

parameters.name: n_side_jnt
parameters.comment: SOURCE: 3 bolts on the back corner and on the closing seam (register 2.9)

parameters.name: side_jnt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 339.31 on P04: 220, 559.31, 898.61 up the 1118.61 edge (register 2.9)

parameters.name: cass_len
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: PROPOSED (WALL): from the side lining's face to seam_gap / 2 short of X 0. Each cassette hangs on its own panel's frame and the closing seam moves (5.2 to 5.8, register 2.11), so the skeleton's touching edges at X 0 could clash; a 2.26 gap matches the skin seam above it (R-J16) and takes the H-14 edge seal

parameters.name: cass_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: lower: the row height; upper: up to lin_gap under the ceiling frame, floating (D-57; P04)

parameters.name: el_trunk_z
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) trunk_z: the cable trunk height in B2-CASS and R1-CASS, above the ledge (about Z 1000), below the R1/R2 joint

parameters.name: el_grm_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) grm_d: the hole for the Heyco 2836 SB 750-625 bushing (maker page); PM 2026-10-31: 19.1, not 20

parameters.name: el_pu_x0
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) pu_x0: the power unit's left side, clear of the closing seam member and its pin-bolt pocket

parameters.name: el_pu_w
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL's final unit size 296 x 260 x 72 (PM 2026-10-31 20:38 UTC; unchanged in its B2 inputs of 2026-11-01): X 95 to 391, on B2's cross members

parameters.name: el_pu_h
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL's final unit size (PM 2026-10-31 20:38 UTC): Z 870 to 1130

parameters.name: el_pu_zc
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) pu_zc: the socket and LAN at the ledge height (D-70)

parameters.name: el_pu_clr
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) pu_clr: the gap round the frame-mounted unit, so the cassette stays floating (= cav_gap)

parameters.name: el_cut_x0
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: B2-CASS cut-out: its left return's inner face (X 91)

parameters.name: el_cut_x1
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) cut_x1: B2-CASS cut-out: its right return's inner face (X 395)

parameters.name: el_cut_z0
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: B2-CASS cut-out: its bottom return's inner face (Z 866)

parameters.name: el_cut_z1
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) cut_z1: B2-CASS cut-out: its top return's inner face (Z 1134)

parameters.name: el_lt_x
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the PM 2026-10-31 20:38 UTC: the light feed moves from X 355 to X 346

parameters.name: el_y_bg
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) y_bg: the middle of the back lining's cable gap (Y 787.5)

parameters.name: el_cs_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) cs_h: half the corner slot in B2-CASS's end return (Y 776-787)

parameters.name: el_cs_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) S-CNR: half the corner slot's length (trunk_z +- 40)

parameters.name: el_y_xc
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) y_xc: the corner crossing (Y 781.5), clear of R1-CASS's back lip

parameters.name: el_tie_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): a Heyco 3904 push-mount cable tie in a Ø6.4 hole through the tray's back sheet; its wings sit behind the sheet, so never in front of a frame member

parameters.name: el_tie_b2_x1
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): B2-CASS tie 1 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z), X 545: none within 150 of the power unit's cut-out

parameters.name: el_tie_b2_x3
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): B2-CASS tie 3 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z), X 1143.5: 22.5 inside the cassette's corner end

parameters.name: el_tie_b2_x2
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): B2-CASS tie 2 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z), halfway: X 844.25 (ELECTRICAL's 844.2)

parameters.name: xm_z0
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the Lead's approval of WALL's B2 frame (2026-11-01): the lower cross member's bottom face; its top face a rivnut head under the unit, which sits on the rivnut heads (ELECTRICAL, 2026-11-01): Z 849.24

parameters.name: xm_z1
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the Lead's approval of WALL's B2 frame (2026-11-01): the upper cross member's top face, its underside a rivnut head over the unit: Z 1150.76

parameters.name: clip_top_dz
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the Lead's approval of WALL's B2 frame (2026-11-01): the top-front clip zone's centre from the cassette's top, at the middle of the stub above the unit (Z 1150.76 to 1210.87): 50.06

parameters.name: ledge_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): galvanized steel sheet, DX51D+Z (EN 10346), Z100; 1.5 (the Lead's ruling the same day) so each rivet's countersink is machined in the upright with land under it, the heads flush and the rail's hole plain: 0.40 clear of the tray at J-FRAME-01's worst case

parameters.name: ledge_r
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: inside bend radius 1 x t, as the trays (the sheet metal rule's)

parameters.name: ledge_out
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the leg from the rail's room face, under the tray's 34 deep bottom return; its tip 10 short of the lining's room face, out of sight

parameters.name: ledge_up
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the upright reaches 2 under the bottom rail's top face

parameters.name: ledge_pad_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: Joints' pick (WALL group, 2026-11-01): Rogers PORON 4701-40, the 320 kg/m3 grade, 2.36 thick (a standard size), PSA one side, slit 18 wide; the ledge's 7.7 kPa squeezes it about 2%, to about 2.31, so the leg sits 2.31 under the frame's bottom and the cassette's bottom stays level with it (the foam is ±10% thick)

parameters.name: ledge_pad_w
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Joints' pick: the pad slit 18 wide, on the leg's flat past its bend

parameters.name: ledge_end
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the ledge's ends 5 inside the right-hand cassette's

parameters.name: ledge_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the back cassette's width less 5 at each end: 1154.9; B1's and B2's the same, so they share 211801

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the hole for 838012, Ø3.3 in the upright and the rail

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_n
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): 6 rivets for the two cassettes' 20.2 kg, about 33 N each

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_e
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the end rivets 40 in from the ledge's ends

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_z
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the rivet line 9 above the frame's bottom: 9.0 from the upright's top edge (2.8 x the Ø3.2 rivet) and the hole's edge 8.2 from the bend

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: even, so the pattern is symmetric and the turned copy (RH) matches: one part

parameters.name: rivet_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): 838012, closed end (D-166), countersunk, aluminium body with a steel mandrel, 3.2 x 8, grip 1.0 to 3.5 for the 1.5 + 1.2 = 2.7; shear 1100 N, tensile 1450 N

parameters.name: rivet_head_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the countersunk head Ø5.8 to 6.7, its largest

parameters.name: rivet_csk_angle
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the head's 120 degrees

parameters.name: rivet_head_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the head's cone: 1.01 deep for Ø6.7 at 120 (the standard allows 1.3 at most: a rim at most 0.3 proud still clears the tray by 0.1 at J-FRAME-01's worst case)

parameters.name: ledge_csk_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the upright's machined countersink: Ø6.7 at the head's 120, the head's largest, so every head (Ø5.8 to 6.7) sits flush or under; 0.52 of the 1.5 upright stays under it at the Ø3.3 hole (a third of its thickness)

parameters.name: rivet_len
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): 8 long overall (its envelope)
